chapters.summary_seed: All right, awesome conversation happening right now, and I wanted to chime in on it because people are arguing whether if our best like athletes play soccer, if we dominate the sport. And this is obviously on the back of that embarrassing loss to Belgium at the World Cup. And there are some good arguments, and I think there's some bad ones as well.
